verdict.rationale: The only mention of SDKs is a changelog note that the retired `/decide` endpoint "was used in older versions of Mixpanel SDKs", which confirms first-party SDKs exist but documents nothing about them. The OpenAPI specs for generating client code are developer building blocks, not official SDKs, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: SDK documentation listing supported languages and platforms, install and usage guides for current SDK versions, any agent-oriented SDK guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
